description: Gate-style heuristic verdict on one fiction chapter (200–400,000 characters): a 1–5 score and binge-worthy flag computed from restatement (repeated passages), dialogue share, a complaint-marker screen and tempo/middle-sag profile. Deterministic — no language model. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

text.description: The chapter text to score (at least 200 characters)

name: chapter_verdict
